record.name: fastfetch
record.description: Fast, actively-maintained neofetch-like system information tool

xdg.instructions: fastfetch's Windows config search list is hardcoded (Win32 known-folder lookups) and ignores XDG_CONFIG_HOME entirely -- confirmed via `fastfetch --list-config-paths` with XDG_CONFIG_HOME set to a probe path. Tools/fastfetch.ps1 wraps the executable and passes --config explicitly, and its one-time setup seeds the themed default config (Tools/fastfetch/config.jsonc).

record.name: glow
record.description: Render Markdown on the CLI

xdg.instructions: glow honors no XDG environment variable. Its config path comes from a Win32 known-folder lookup (immune to APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA), GLAMOUR_STYLE is never read, and GLOW_STYLE loses to the non-TTY downgrade. Tools/glow.ps1 wraps the executable and passes --config and -s explicitly.
